summary: Frontend-only verification of the NEW live cover-page preview panel inside SubmissionPackWizard for tender 'MOD Gym Estate Framework 2026' (Iso Demo Fitness CRM). All required preview behaviours pass: section renders, button toggles label to 'Refresh preview' once an image is shown, ITT & traceability modes return HTTP 200 image_b64 data URLs and paint , templated mode without a template shows the 'Pick a template to preview.' error, and switching modes triggers a debounced auto-refresh (network call fired ~1.3s after each mode switch).
critical_code_review_comments: SubmissionPackWizard: token editor (pack-token-find-0/pack-token-replace-0) is only mounted when mode==='templated' with a template selected. The review request asked to verify that editing tokens auto-refreshes preview; this is unreachable without first uploading/selecting a template. Not a bug — expected — but worth main agent's awareness that this scenario cannot be exercised on the seeded tender without adding a template upload step to the flow.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing tender 'MOD Gym Estate Framework 2026' (id e4cee641-4430-466d-b126-9cc88c96f074).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview panel verified end-to-end. Access path: login at /crm as owner@isodemo.com, set localStorage.crm_active_mode='business', navigate to /crm?tab=tenders, open 'MOD Gym Estate Framework 2026', click data-testid=export-pack-btn to open wizard. Preview render latency ~3-6s (LibreOffice). Observed image sizes: ITT ~32.5KB, traceability ~42.5KB (both b64 data URLs). Templated-without-template correctly surfaces error via data-testid=pack-preview-error. Button label toggles Preview cover page → Refresh preview once image is present. Debounced auto-refresh (~1.3s) fires POST /api/crm/v2/tenders/{id}/export/preview on mode change (verified 3x 200 responses across ITT/traceability/templated switches).

test_observations.default_mode_on_open: templated (shows 'Pick a template to preview.' error when preview clicked with no template)
test_observations.auto_refresh_on_mode_switch: confirmed — network call POST /export/preview fired within ~1.3s debounce after each pack-mode-* click
